cases.source:
SYNTHETIC SUPPLIER AGREEMENT — evaluation only
Customer: Cedar Labs. Supplier: Harbour Systems. Annual fee: USD 48000.

Customer has unlimited liability for all losses, including indirect and consequential damages.

Each party indemnifies the other against third-party claims arising from its own negligence, willful misconduct, or breach of this agreement, subject to the liability cap.

The agreement renews annually unless either party gives notice at least thirty days before renewal.

Supplier may terminate for convenience only on thirty days' written notice and must refund unused prepaid fees.

Supplier shall delete customer data within thirty days of termination and give prior notice of new subprocessors.

expected_evidence.P1: Customer has unlimited liability for all losses, including indirect and consequential damages.
